💵 Click the icon below to join Pinewood Builders for extra +1 per event credits!

Thank you Jay Cosmic for permission to use your song. Helpers and credits can be found in game.

The first and original core game with a meltdown on Roblox.

games.name: Avoid Asgore as Dess [Deltarune]
games.desc:
THIS IS A REUPLOAD OF THE GAME!!! THE ORIGINAL GAME WAS LOST IN A SCAM!!! The other "Evade Asgore As Dess [Deltarune]" is being ran by scammers. If you would like proof please contact me via the community server. 

[Game is still in early access/beta, expect bugs and glitches]

A player is randomly chosen to be either a Driver or a Runner. The goal of the driver is to run over all other runners, while the goal of the runner is to survive for aslong as possible. Kromer that is earned during rounds can be spent on many new runners and drivers

Controls 

Pc : 
Shift to sprint
Q to use ability
E to use secondary ability

Mobile :
Onscreen buttons for everything

Game is heavily inspired by Undertale and Deltarune, most assets are from both of those.

games.name: Robotomy Corporation VANITIES [v1.8.5]
games.desc:
🔨 Shutdown = Update/Bug Fixes
If you find any bugs, please report them to the community!

New Icon was made by @lolkek, thank you for submitting art!

Welcome to Robotomy Corporation 

Your job here is to manage abnormalities and to collect energy.
Death is not an end to your work. There is no living in here. Good luck.

What you can do in this game:
- 📝 Start working on abnormalities and start getting PE-Boxes to meet the energy quota! 
- ⚔️ Suppress abnormalities and bring them back to their containment!
- ❤️ Assist your team members and start working as a team
- 👨‍💼 Be a manager and use your iron fist to run the company.

Controls:
Tab - View stats
Mouse Scroll - Zoom camera
Click on Containment Door - Work with abnormalities
R - Special for certain weapons

This game is largely inspired by Lobotomy Corporation. 

A remake is being worked on. This game will have a final update on v2.0.

Tags:
Lobotomy Corporation, SCP, Abnormality, Manager, Library of Ruina
